title: Bayesian statistics as a Wikipedia school
dek: Encyclopedia school: priors, posteriors, reporting a distribution. Computation and calibration stay on existing stats-* plates.
story: Wikipedia's Bayesian statistics article is a school name: unknown quantities get probability distributions, updated by Bayes' theorem. It will mention controversies with frequentist testing that this studio refuses to turn into a personality fight.

stats-bayesian already does the updating. stats-mcmc, stats-priors, stats-conjugacy, stats-eight-schools already do the work. This card is the encyclopedia school node that should related[] into those ids.
A 'Bayesian analysis' caption that never shows a prior, a diagnostic, or a posterior interval is using the school as perfume.
deep: Credible intervals are not confidence intervals (wiki-credible-interval).
Hierarchical Bayes is stats-hierarchical / partial pooling.
WAIC/LOO are predictive criteria closer to AIC than to a posterior probability of a model.

visual.caption: School-name neighbours. Size is how often a TB-lab notebook actually needs the object.
